tw.description:
征服地牢。否則，就被地牢征服。

回合制牌組構築 Roguelite——地牢合併！
每次冒險，不同的策略。不同的英雄。不同的結局。

■ 獨具特色的英雄——不只是數值不同，玩法也截然不同。

刺客：對單一目標造成雙倍傷害。鎖定目標，一擊制勝。
工程師：累積護盾，釋放毀滅性的範圍攻擊。防禦就是進攻。
賭徒：升級時免費重抽選項。讓運氣也成為策略。
貴族：升級選項+1，還能在神殿花費金幣升級。金錢就是武器。

……每位英雄，都需要完全不同的策略。

■ 豐富的技能卡牌——重點不是收集，而是組合。你的牌組就是你的策略。

連鎖閃電：連續攻擊最多3名敵人
雙重施法：連續發動兩次相同技能
複製：立即複製牌組中的任意卡牌

技能品質：普通 → 稀有 → 史詩 → 傳說
在戰鬥中強化卡牌，創造強大的技能組合。

■ 強大的遺物——有時，一件遺物就能改變一切。

聖杯：死亡時以50%生命值復活一次
崩塌碎片：接下來3場戰鬥中，所有非首領敵人以1點生命值登場
束縛枷鎖：每回合魔力+1，但商店價格上漲25%
聖域提燈：每次進入商店時完全恢復生命值

■ 各具特色的敵人——每場戰鬥都是全新的謎題。看不透敵人的行動，就無法生存。

寶藏哥布林：若未在7回合內擊敗，便會逃跑
雪人：凍結玩家1回合
烏鴉：強制隨機棄掉一張手牌

還有擁有獨特攻擊模式與多個戰鬥階段的強大首領。

■ 封印系統——真正的挑戰從這裡開始。

普通模式僅僅是開始。
隨著封印逐漸解鎖，更加殘酷的挑戰接踵而至。

自由組合試煉與契約，打造專屬於你的遊戲難度。
只有極少數玩家能夠征服最困難的組合。

■ 挑戰模式——每週新規則，每週新競爭。

每週輪替的大契約與試煉。
在熟悉的策略不再奏效的環境中，尋找最強牌組搭配。

與其他玩家爭奪最高分，挑戰每週排行榜。
突破挑戰的最終區域，即可進入無盡戰場。

面對不斷變強的敵人，你究竟能撐多久？

■ 無限重玩樂趣

3個區域 × 11層——每次冒險都會隨機生成的地牢
戰鬥、事件、精英、神殿、商店等豐富的房間類型
每次都有不同的地圖、敵人組合與卡牌獎勵

即使選擇相同的英雄，也不會有完全相同的冒險。

■ 遊戲特色

回合制策略 + 牌組構築 Roguelite
各具特色的英雄、技能、遺物與敵人
封印系統——透過試煉與契約自訂難度
挑戰模式——每週變化的規則與排行榜競爭
無盡戰場——挑戰極限的無盡戰鬥
隨機生成的地牢
支援多種語言
雲端存檔

用屬於你的策略，徹底征服地牢。
一次冒險，遠遠不夠。

tw.releaseNotes:
Hello Hello, iPhone Duo
- New support for iPhone Duo, with layouts for both screens.

Deco is now free
- Deco is now free to download, with Deco Plus available as a one-time purchase. Choose your price—every option includes all Plus features.
- The free library includes three wallpapers, two widgets and ten saved stickers.
- If you bought Deco before 3.0, you keep your paid access.

A whole new canvas
- A completely redesigned canvas and editor give your artwork more room, with tools that adapt to iPhone and iPad.
- One creation can become wallpapers in multiple sizes, including iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and custom dimensions.
- Create a different sticker layout for each wallpaper size and orientation.
- Search and reorder stickers in Layers, with undo and redo across your canvas edits.
- Select several stickers and move, resize or rotate them together.
- Group stickers into a single layer, with individual stickers still available to edit.

Make it move
- Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects.
- New reveal animations bring stickers into view with Fade In, Staggered, Bloom and Bounce.
- Preview animations before exporting, and animate or pause individual Live sticker effects.

Stickers with more character
- An expanded collection of finishes includes Chrome, Glitter, Embroidery, Holographic and new print effects.
- Separate strength and pattern-size controls give you more ways to shape each effect.
- Text stickers gain colour and font choices, and sticker opacity is adjustable in Sticker Studio and on your creations.

Create together, with iCloud
- Your creations and sticker library come to your other devices with new iCloud sync.
- Collaborate on editable creations through iCloud, with Activity History showing recent changes.

Beyond your wallpaper
- Create Home Screen widgets in their own library, with a separate layout for each size.
- Export and import editable widget files.
- Export your creations as Apple Watch faces.
- Deco Live for Mac is available as an early access download in Settings.

Find your next idea
- A new Explore tab brings together ideas, guides and a featured creation to make your own.
- Redesigned libraries give your wallpapers, widgets and stickers more room.
- Find creations and stickers by what their images show, with search on your device.

And more
- Wallpaper orientation can optionally follow your device as you turn it.
- Top Picks tailors celebration suggestions to your region.
- Optional automatic names for wallpapers and widgets using Apple’s Private Cloud Compute.
- New Shortcuts actions create random or custom wallpapers and work with selected or random stickers.
- Saved stickers can appear in the system sticker picker.
- Search Settings and change matching controls directly in the results.
- Rotate photo backgrounds, with improved framing, stripe editing and gradient controls.

---

3.0.1 Hotfix

- Fixed a crash that could prevent Deco from opening on iOS 26.
- Tapping + in Wallpapers starts a new creation again.
- Rotate photo backgrounds with a two-finger twist.
- Improved photo editing with more space around the preview, animated transitions between controls and clearer spacing between zoom percentages.
- Available wallpaper previews now remain visible when another layout’s thumbnail is missing. Missing previews show “Preview unavailable” without preventing editing.
- Delete wallpapers or leave shared wallpapers while offline; changes sync when connected.
- Fixed unresponsive widget previews and missing rounded corners in Widgets.
- Clearer error screens when an export can’t be prepared.
- Creation details now explain when sticker content is unavailable, with one Retry action.
tw.description:
Make wallpapers, widgets, and watch faces with your photos, text, emoji, and stickers. Create something for your own screens or share it with friends.

MAKE IT YOURS
Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers.

WALLPAPERS, WIDGETS, AND WATCH FACES
Make wallpapers for iPhone and iPad or choose custom dimensions. Create Home Screen widgets with a separate layout for each size. Export your artwork as an Apple Watch face. Use your saved stickers in Messages, too.

CREATE AND SHARE
Send an image, share an editable copy, or invite friends to a shared creation. Choose who can view or edit. Friends can join for free.

ADD MOVEMENT AND TEXTURE
Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects. Try finishes including chrome, holographic, glitter, embroidery, and risograph, and preview animations as you work.

KEEP YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU
Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs.

DECO PLUS
Start free with up to three wallpapers, two widgets, and ten saved stickers. Unlock more with Deco Plus, available as a one-time purchase. Every price option includes the same Plus features. If you bought Deco before version 3.0, you keep your paid access.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.aethers.world/deco/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

tw.releaseNotes:
Huge Bug Fix!
Black Border 3 is Now Out!
tw.description:
Inspect papers, prevent smuggling—keep the border safe or profit from corruption.

Ready to become a Border Police Officer? Step into the world of Black Border 2: Border Patrol Simulator and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling. Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game.

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.

NEW FEATURES in Black Border 2:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports and permits to approve or reject entrants as a customs officer.

Endless Mode: Test your border patrol skills in a nonstop, challenging experience.

Bus Arrivals: Manage large buses and check every passenger's documents carefully.

Advanced Scanning: Utilize new X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and contraband.

Weigh Stations: Ensure vehicle weights match their records, a key part of your police duty.

Canine Unit: Your faithful service dog is now a crucial partner in finding hidden contraband.

Each day as a border inspector brings new challenges that will push your customs police skills to the limit. Are you ready to face the pressure and become a true hero of national security?

Download Black Border 2 today and get ready to defend the nation!

tw.releaseNotes:
You Asked, We Listened!

Help Section Added: A comprehensive help section is now available to guide you through the app’s features and functionalities, making it easier to navigate and use the app effectively.

New Tap and Hold Feature: You can now tap and hold buttons to change the selected course and track when the aircraft is stationary, providing smoother navigation adjustments. The option to tap and drag to rotate the compass card remains available for added flexibility
tw.description:
Turn your iPad or iPhone into a powerful IFR training tool!

The IFR Trainer is a simple yet effective tool designed to enhance your instrument flight training. Practice course and radial tracking on your device, saving valuable time during your actual flight training.

The IFR Trainer features an Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI) with a DME reading and two bearing pointers. Use the EHSI to intercept VOR radials or track NDB bearings. Alternatively, switch to a landscape dual-gauge mode, displaying both an HSI and a single-needle ADF Indicator with a manually adjustable compass card.

For optimal performance, we recommend using the dark appearance mode, which complies with EASA AMC 25-11. The light appearance mode is ideal for classroom presentations.

tw.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

tw.description:
像看一本玄幻小说一样参与修仙：你本是小村凡人，因一场怪梦得见上古「逆命书」残页——书中每一页，都是你可能走过的命途。梦醒后你决意寻仙，跋涉入山，炼气入门。

从炼气到飞升，逆命书共十章：与同门结怨、筑基后种下仇怨、金丹时与仇家狭路相逢、元婴后面临夺舍与天条、化神斩心魔、炼虚入秘境、合体大乘直至渡劫。成则仙门洞开，败则魂飞魄散。每一次选择都在改写命线，飞升成仙只是其中一种终章——寿元耗尽、渡劫失败、心魔反噬、仇家所杀、天罚降临等十四种结局，皆有可能。
· 十章主线，承上启下——每突破一境翻开新一卷，卷首语与剧情卡紧扣同门恩怨、仇家围杀、逆命书梦境，像看连载小说。
· 200 个随机事件，三选项多结果——山间灵泉、坊市奇遇、妖兽拦路、秘境崩塌、仇家寻踪……每局顺序不同，选择即落笔。
· 十境渡劫，一步一生死——炼气→筑基→金丹→元婴→化神→炼虚→合体→大乘→渡劫→飞升，渡劫有成功率，失败即道消，可搭配功法与渡劫丹。
· 功法·丹药·背包——多种功法与道具可装备与使用，针对境界与天劫做搭配，轻度养成。
· 单机无氪——无联网、无内购、无广告，进度本地保存，一次下载体验完整内容。
· 深色古风界面，境界主题色随突破变化，渡劫成功有金色闪光与音效触觉反馈。

命途多歧，唯你落笔。再续仙缘，可从头再走一遍十章，追求飞升或解锁不同终章。

- 单机运行：无需服务器，不收集个人数据，可完全离线游玩。
- 无广告：界面干净，无插屏、无激励视频，专注修炼与抉择。

【玩法简介】
从炼气到飞升，共十重境界。随机触发历练事件，每次选择会影响修为、灵石、寿元与气运。境界突破需渡劫，成功率与当前状态、功法、丹药相关，成败一念之间。支持多种灵根与功法，不同路线带来不同体验。

【关于付费】
应用内提供一次性的可选解锁项，仅需 3 元即可永久解锁全部内容，无订阅、无重复扣费。购买后即可离线使用，无额外依赖。

A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

us.description:
Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge!
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

…Every hero demands a different strategy.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers.

Welcome to This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker - a unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?
Steam: Very Positive, 89%

GROW YOUR HAND
Buy new cards to increase your odds of hitting good hands. If you're rich enough, you can even break the rules and get over 5 cards.

ESTABLISH DOMINANCE
Even though the Jester doesn't like it, you can buy new decks of cards in order to play more hands at once. Use this to your advantage to grow those numbers even faster!

GET UPGRADED
Buy powerful upgrades using your hard earned coins, enabling you to progress quicker, open up new avenues, and take on the evil Jester!

GO ON EXPEDITIONS
Once unlocked, you can send your minions on expeditions to discover new otherworldy cards with powerful benefits. Upgrade these missions to provide even more powerful benefits as you progress. You can even unlock missions to destroy cards from your deck that you don't want, to ensure every hand is exactly how you want it.

ASCEND TO GREATNESS

ESCAPE THE HOUSE OF CARDS
You're trapped in the Jester's domain, can you manage to defeat him and escape? Or will he keep you there, trapped forever in an endless cycle?

Everything you need to make your photos look incredible

• Effortlessly remove unwanted objects using an incredible object removal tool

• Intelligently crop photos using the AI-powered auto-cropping
• Copy the look of any photo to another using the incredible Match Colors feature

State-of-the-art color adjustments
• Enjoy powerful tools for effortlessly adjusting the temperature, tint, exposure, contrast, brightness, hue, saturation, and vibrance in your photos
• Recover incredible amounts of detail in the highlights and shadows of photos
• Magically enhance fine details and structure in photos using powerful Clarity and Texture adjustments, or adjust textures in the highlights, midtones, and shadows separately
• Selectively edit individual color ranges with Selective Color, or improve the balance of colors in the shadows, midtones, and highlights with Color Balance
• Adjust lighting and colors with full precision using Levels and Curves adjustments
• Mix the balance of the red, green, and blue color channels to create intense color effects in your images

• Use a range of additional adjustments, like Sharpen, Fade, Grain, Color Monochrome, Sepia, and Invert to make your photos stand out

Compatibility

• With the support for iCloud Drive, enjoy seamless edit syncing across Mac, iPhone, and iPad
• Photomator is built from the ground up for iPhone and iPad with a native design that blends seamlessly with the sleek and modern look of iOS and iPadOS 18

us.description:
Turn your iPad or iPhone into a powerful IFR training tool!

The IFR Trainer is a simple yet effective tool designed to enhance your instrument flight training. Practice course and radial tracking on your device, saving valuable time during your actual flight training.

The IFR Trainer features an Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI) with a DME reading and two bearing pointers. Use the EHSI to intercept VOR radials or track NDB bearings. Alternatively, switch to a landscape dual-gauge mode, displaying both an HSI and a single-needle ADF Indicator with a manually adjustable compass card.

For optimal performance, we recommend using the dark appearance mode, which complies with EASA AMC 25-11. The light appearance mode is ideal for classroom presentations.

us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

us.description:
像看一本玄幻小说一样参与修仙：你本是小村凡人，因一场怪梦得见上古「逆命书」残页——书中每一页，都是你可能走过的命途。梦醒后你决意寻仙，跋涉入山，炼气入门。

从炼气到飞升，逆命书共十章：与同门结怨、筑基后种下仇怨、金丹时与仇家狭路相逢、元婴后面临夺舍与天条、化神斩心魔、炼虚入秘境、合体大乘直至渡劫。成则仙门洞开，败则魂飞魄散。每一次选择都在改写命线，飞升成仙只是其中一种终章——寿元耗尽、渡劫失败、心魔反噬、仇家所杀、天罚降临等十四种结局，皆有可能。
· 十章主线，承上启下——每突破一境翻开新一卷，卷首语与剧情卡紧扣同门恩怨、仇家围杀、逆命书梦境，像看连载小说。
· 200 个随机事件，三选项多结果——山间灵泉、坊市奇遇、妖兽拦路、秘境崩塌、仇家寻踪……每局顺序不同，选择即落笔。
· 十境渡劫，一步一生死——炼气→筑基→金丹→元婴→化神→炼虚→合体→大乘→渡劫→飞升，渡劫有成功率，失败即道消，可搭配功法与渡劫丹。
· 功法·丹药·背包——多种功法与道具可装备与使用，针对境界与天劫做搭配，轻度养成。
· 单机无氪——无联网、无内购、无广告，进度本地保存，一次下载体验完整内容。
· 深色古风界面，境界主题色随突破变化，渡劫成功有金色闪光与音效触觉反馈。

命途多歧，唯你落笔。再续仙缘，可从头再走一遍十章，追求飞升或解锁不同终章。

- 单机运行：无需服务器，不收集个人数据，可完全离线游玩。
- 无广告：界面干净，无插屏、无激励视频，专注修炼与抉择。
- 本地存储：进度与存档均存于设备，不上传云端，你可随时备份或删除。

【玩法简介】
从炼气到飞升，共十重境界。随机触发历练事件，每次选择会影响修为、灵石、寿元与气运。境界突破需渡劫，成功率与当前状态、功法、丹药相关，成败一念之间。支持多种灵根与功法，不同路线带来不同体验。

【关于付费】
应用内提供一次性的可选解锁项，仅需 3 元即可永久解锁全部内容，无订阅、无重复扣费。购买后即可离线使用，无额外依赖。

us.description:
Cyber Manhunt is a Cyber-Style, Realistic- Society theme, Story-Rich indie game. The game taked place in the Republic of Alivia with some different theme stories ,but the fate of the characters is closely related in there. It will focus on social issues liking big data, hacking, citizen privacy etc... 

We want to reveal the profound themes behind the stories with wonderful plots and gamification. And let players pay more attention to Cyber Violence and Privacy Breaches.

[Contents]
◆Chapter I: Death of a Programmer
The CEO of a company committed suicide by jumping off a building, and claimed that he was extorted tens of millions by his wife. While his wife posted photos of domestic violence on social networks. Who is lying?
◆Chapter II: Invisible Eyes
The indecent video of the female college student went viral on the Internet. At this moment, she was already socially dead. Who is the initiator? Who should protect the safety of women?
◆Chapter III: The Evidence Vanishes
The student council president, who is both excellent in character and study, suddenly disappeared. The bullying incident made the case more complicated. Who is the murderer and who is the victim?
◆Chapter IV: The Price of Humiliation
The female singer has been exposed again! Threatening letters, hype, the suicide of former girl group members... The Internet has set off a public opinion carnival again!
◆Chapter V: Immortal Code
When the society is in madness, are you willing to join the Immortal Code to obtain true love and immortality?
◆DLC: Home Sweet Home
Behind this seemingly sweet and happy family, everyone has their own secrets, what is the truth hidden behind?!
◆DLC: Hello World!
Senior researcher of Titan Dr. Lucrezia died in a terrible car accident on the spot, but the fellow Benjamin took escape from death. But he did not realize that he was about to be involved in a huge conspiracy…

◆Highly Immersive: Gamers play as a hacker in the game, accepts the commission of the company, and solve dangerous incidents.

Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game
Begin your role playing game (RPG) journey as a new recruit in the Shoru Police Academy. Creo Monsters are disappearing, and it's your mission to uncover the truth behind these mysterious events. But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Along the way, assist the citizens of Shoru by completing over 50 engaging missions, building alliances, and discovering hidden treasures.

Capture and Train Over 300 Monsters
Love monster-collecting games? Build your RPG dream team of Creo in this open-world role playing game. Hunt rare and legendary monsters, each available in unique alternate colors. With over 300 unique monsters to capture, evolve, and train, you’ll have endless possibilities to customize your strategy in pocket monster games. Create powerful combinations and lead your Creo to victory in thrilling turn-based battles.

Explore this monster adventure game
Experience more than 30 hours of offline and online rpg gameplay as you dive into a richly detailed open world. From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter
Prepare for trainer battles with a highly customizable system. Equip your Creo with items and unlock over 100 unique traits to enhance their abilities. Train your Creo to learn and master over 200 moves, which you can swap anytime to adapt to new challenges. Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Master Trainer
Challenge the strongest monster trainers across Shoru and rise through the ranks in this paid role playing game. Compete in the prestigious Coliseum, where only the best monster trainers are crowned as champions. Will you conquer every rpg battle and claim the title of Evoking Master Trainer?

- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide

- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

tr.description:
A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

tr.description:
Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge!
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

…Every hero demands a different strategy.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

tr.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

tr.description:
像看一本玄幻小说一样参与修仙：你本是小村凡人，因一场怪梦得见上古「逆命书」残页——书中每一页，都是你可能走过的命途。梦醒后你决意寻仙，跋涉入山，炼气入门。

从炼气到飞升，逆命书共十章：与同门结怨、筑基后种下仇怨、金丹时与仇家狭路相逢、元婴后面临夺舍与天条、化神斩心魔、炼虚入秘境、合体大乘直至渡劫。成则仙门洞开，败则魂飞魄散。每一次选择都在改写命线，飞升成仙只是其中一种终章——寿元耗尽、渡劫失败、心魔反噬、仇家所杀、天罚降临等十四种结局，皆有可能。
· 十章主线，承上启下——每突破一境翻开新一卷，卷首语与剧情卡紧扣同门恩怨、仇家围杀、逆命书梦境，像看连载小说。
· 200 个随机事件，三选项多结果——山间灵泉、坊市奇遇、妖兽拦路、秘境崩塌、仇家寻踪……每局顺序不同，选择即落笔。
· 十境渡劫，一步一生死——炼气→筑基→金丹→元婴→化神→炼虚→合体→大乘→渡劫→飞升，渡劫有成功率，失败即道消，可搭配功法与渡劫丹。
· 功法·丹药·背包——多种功法与道具可装备与使用，针对境界与天劫做搭配，轻度养成。
· 单机无氪——无联网、无内购、无广告，进度本地保存，一次下载体验完整内容。
· 深色古风界面，境界主题色随突破变化，渡劫成功有金色闪光与音效触觉反馈。

命途多歧，唯你落笔。再续仙缘，可从头再走一遍十章，追求飞升或解锁不同终章。

- 单机运行：无需服务器，不收集个人数据，可完全离线游玩。
- 无广告：界面干净，无插屏、无激励视频，专注修炼与抉择。
- 本地存储：进度与存档均存于设备，不上传云端，你可随时备份或删除。

【玩法简介】
从炼气到飞升，共十重境界。随机触发历练事件，每次选择会影响修为、灵石、寿元与气运。境界突破需渡劫，成功率与当前状态、功法、丹药相关，成败一念之间。支持多种灵根与功法，不同路线带来不同体验。

【关于付费】
应用内提供一次性的可选解锁项，仅需 3 元即可永久解锁全部内容，无订阅、无重复扣费。购买后即可离线使用，无额外依赖。

pt.description:
A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

pt.description:
Já imaginou como é estar na linha da frente da segurança nacional?

Em Black Border 2, você assume o papel de um agente da Polícia de Fronteira, enfrentando situações desafiantes a cada turno. Com visuais detalhados e jogabilidade envolvente, este jogo oferece uma experiência realista incomparável que coloca você no centro da ação.

Assuma a responsabilidade de proteger as fronteiras do seu país contra o contrabando ilegal. Inspecione veículos, reveja documentos e enfrente contrabandistas que tentam traficar drogas, armas e outras mercadorias ilegais.

Cada dia traz novos desafios, onde pensamento rápido e visão aguçada são as suas melhores ferramentas. Você é mais do que um simples agente de fronteira — você é a última linha de defesa.

Funcionalidades de Black Border 2:

    Simulação autêntica de patrulha de fronteira: Coloque-se no papel de um verdadeiro agente, onde cada decisão conta e cada interação está carregada de tensão.

    Inspeção detalhada de documentos: Analise cuidadosamente passaportes, autorizações e outros documentos para decidir quem pode entrar e quem deve ser barrado.

    Deteção de contrabando: Realize buscas minuciosas em veículos e inspeções pessoais para capturar criminosos que tentam contrabandear mercadorias ilegais.

    Personagens dinâmicos com IA: Interaja com personagens realistas que reagem e se adaptam com base nas suas decisões e ações.

    Desafios crescentes: Desde pequenos erros em documentos até grandes redes de contrabando, enfrente missões cada vez mais intensas que vão testar os seus limites.

advisories: Uso pouco frequente/moderado de temas de terror/medo
Uso pouco frequente/moderado de violência fantástica ou em desenhos animados
pt.releaseNotes:
Novo Cenário: Antivacina

A fé nas vacinas está ruindo. Campanhas globais de vacinação lutam para resistir, mas conspirações usadas como armas e a desinformação viral estão infectando a verdade! O que de pior poderia acontecer?

Novo Tipo de População: Vacinados; eles já são imunes à sua doença! Como você os tornará vulneráveis?
pt.description:
Você consegue contaminar o mundo? Plague Inc. é uma mistura única de alta estratégia e simulação terrivelmente realista. 

Seu agente patogênico acabou de contaminar o 'Paciente zero'. Agora você deve acabar com a história da humanidade evoluindo para uma mortal Praga global, enquanto se adapta a tudo que a humanidade pode fazer para se defender. 

Brilhantemente executado, com jogabilidade inovadora e construido especificamente para iPhone e iPad, Plague Inc. é uma evolução do gênero de estratégia e leva os jogos em dispositivos móves (e você) a novos níveis. É Você contra o mundo - só o forte sobrevive!

pt.description:
Bem-vindo a This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker - um jogo incremental único no qual você vira cartas para ganhar dinheiro, melhora sua mão, compra novos baralhos, desbloqueia poderosos aprimoramentos, descobre novas cartas e muito mais. Você conseguirá derrotar o curinga e escapar do carnaval?
Steam: Muito positivas, 89%

MELHORE SUA MÃO
Compre novas cartas para melhorar suas chances de obter mãos boas. Se tiver dinheiro suficiente, você pode até mesmo quebrar as regras e conseguir mais de 5 cartas.

ESTABELEÇA SEU DOMÍNIO
Ainda que o curinga não goste, você pode comprar novos baralhos para jogar mais de uma mão ao mesmo tempo. Use isso para conseguir a vantagem e aumentar seus números ainda mais rápido.

APRIMORE-SE
Compre poderosos aprimoramentos utilizando suas merecidas moedas para acelerar seu progresso, abrir novos caminhos e enfrentar o curinga maligno!

PARTA EM EXPEDIÇÕES
Após desbloquear essa funcionalidade, você pode enviar lacaios em expedições para descobrir novas cartas sobrenaturais com benefícios poderosos. Aprimore essas missões para obter benefícios ainda mais poderosos enquanto avança. Você pode até mesmo desbloquear missões para destruir cartas do seu baralho e garantir que cada mão esteja exatamente da forma que deseja.

ALCANCE A GRANDEZA
Faça um acordo com o curinga para recomeçar em troca de fichas de pôquer (fichas de pôquer? Mas isso sequer é pôquer...?) e utilize-as para comprar aprimoramentos ainda mais poderosos.

ESCAPE DO CASTELO DE CARTAS
O curinga prendeu você em seus domínios. Você conseguirá derrotá-lo e escapar? Ou ele vai conseguir manter você lá para sempre em um ciclo sem fim?

pt.description:
Turn your iPad or iPhone into a powerful IFR training tool!

The IFR Trainer is a simple yet effective tool designed to enhance your instrument flight training. Practice course and radial tracking on your device, saving valuable time during your actual flight training.

The IFR Trainer features an Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI) with a DME reading and two bearing pointers. Use the EHSI to intercept VOR radials or track NDB bearings. Alternatively, switch to a landscape dual-gauge mode, displaying both an HSI and a single-needle ADF Indicator with a manually adjustable compass card.

For optimal performance, we recommend using the dark appearance mode, which complies with EASA AMC 25-11. The light appearance mode is ideal for classroom presentations.

Keep the words, pictures, videos, voice and positions you want to record at any time and anywhere.
And there are reminders that you can never forget.

Make wallpapers, widgets, and watch faces with your photos, text, emoji, and stickers. Create something for your own screens or share it with friends.

MAKE IT YOURS
Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers.

WALLPAPERS, WIDGETS, AND WATCH FACES
Make wallpapers for iPhone and iPad or choose custom dimensions. Create Home Screen widgets with a separate layout for each size. Export your artwork as an Apple Watch face. Use your saved stickers in Messages, too.

CREATE AND SHARE
Send an image, share an editable copy, or invite friends to a shared creation. Choose who can view or edit. Friends can join for free.

ADD MOVEMENT AND TEXTURE
Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects. Try finishes including chrome, holographic, glitter, embroidery, and risograph, and preview animations as you work.

KEEP YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU
Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs.

DECO PLUS
Start free with up to three wallpapers, two widgets, and ten saved stickers. Unlock more with Deco Plus, available as a one-time purchase. Every price option includes the same Plus features. If you bought Deco before version 3.0, you keep your paid access.

pt.releaseNotes:

Create together, with iCloud

Beyond your wallpaper

Find your next idea

And more

pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

pt.trackName: 上瘾修仙 - 上头的单机新形态文字游戏
pt.releaseNotes:
修复bug。
增加更多剧情。
pt.description:
像看一本玄幻小说一样参与修仙：你本是小村凡人，因一场怪梦得见上古「逆命书」残页——书中每一页，都是你可能走过的命途。梦醒后你决意寻仙，跋涉入山，炼气入门。

从炼气到飞升，逆命书共十章：与同门结怨、筑基后种下仇怨、金丹时与仇家狭路相逢、元婴后面临夺舍与天条、化神斩心魔、炼虚入秘境、合体大乘直至渡劫。成则仙门洞开，败则魂飞魄散。每一次选择都在改写命线，飞升成仙只是其中一种终章——寿元耗尽、渡劫失败、心魔反噬、仇家所杀、天罚降临等十四种结局，皆有可能。
· 十章主线，承上启下——每突破一境翻开新一卷，卷首语与剧情卡紧扣同门恩怨、仇家围杀、逆命书梦境，像看连载小说。
· 200 个随机事件，三选项多结果——山间灵泉、坊市奇遇、妖兽拦路、秘境崩塌、仇家寻踪……每局顺序不同，选择即落笔。
· 十境渡劫，一步一生死——炼气→筑基→金丹→元婴→化神→炼虚→合体→大乘→渡劫→飞升，渡劫有成功率，失败即道消，可搭配功法与渡劫丹。
· 功法·丹药·背包——多种功法与道具可装备与使用，针对境界与天劫做搭配，轻度养成。
· 单机无氪——无联网、无内购、无广告，进度本地保存，一次下载体验完整内容。
· 深色古风界面，境界主题色随突破变化，渡劫成功有金色闪光与音效触觉反馈。

命途多歧，唯你落笔。再续仙缘，可从头再走一遍十章，追求飞升或解锁不同终章。

- 单机运行：无需服务器，不收集个人数据，可完全离线游玩。
- 无广告：界面干净，无插屏、无激励视频，专注修炼与抉择。
- 本地存储：进度与存档均存于设备，不上传云端，你可随时备份或删除。

【玩法简介】
从炼气到飞升，共十重境界。随机触发历练事件，每次选择会影响修为、灵石、寿元与气运。境界突破需渡劫，成功率与当前状态、功法、丹药相关，成败一念之间。支持多种灵根与功法，不同路线带来不同体验。

【关于付费】
应用内提供一次性的可选解锁项，仅需 3 元即可永久解锁全部内容，无订阅、无重复扣费。购买后即可离线使用，无额外依赖。
